title: Side Lateral Raise Mistake: Raise Your Elbows, Not Your Hands
hook: Most people do side laterals wrong.
body: At the top of the rep, your elbow has to be high. If your elbow stays low and only your hands come up, your delts are not really being worked. Lead with the elbow.
close: And make sure there's no rocking.
youtube_description:
The side lateral raise mistake that stops your shoulders from working.
